---
title: Run a command-line script
---




`syntaxer_main.py` uses a configured language model to analyze a passage and print the result to standard output. Create an `.env` to configure your LM credentials, like this:

```bash
API_BASE=https://localmodel/api
MODEL=litellm/modelname
API_KEY=your-key-here
```

Then run `syntaxer_main.py`:

```bash
python3 syntaxer_main.py --passage "Gallia est omnis divisa in partes tres."
```

To include a citation reference (e.g. a CTS URN), use the `--citation` argument:

```bash
python3 syntaxer_main.py --passage "Arma virumque canō." --citation "urn:cts:latinLit:phi0690.phi003.perseus:1.1"
```

Redirect the output to a file with standard IO redirection:

```bash
python3 syntaxer_main.py --passage "Arma virumque canō." 
    --citation "urn:cts:latinLit:phi0690.phi003.perseus:1.1" > aeneid_analysis.cex
```
